ideas.pitch: A tool that uses agentic AI to inspect, validate, and auto-correct full-stack codebases against business logic workflow standards.
ideas.title: AgenticBPMN: Autonomous Workflow Evaluator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines multi-agent debugging patterns with automated process orchestration, directly targeting the Agentic AI track focus.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous runtime error investigator that traces full-stack exceptions, generates root-cause analysis, and drafts automated test patches.
ideas.title: StackPulse: Real-Time Full-Stack Regression Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, painful developer workflow problem with a live, demonstrable debugging loop that works out-of-the-box.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router using vector indices and local evaluation writebacks to optimize LLM query dispatch cost and latency.
ideas.title: OpenInference: Open-Source LLM Semantic Routing Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings rigorous systems engineering and low-latency optimization to open innovation, matching the technical depth seen in winning semantic routing architectures.

ideas.pitch: A low-code node integration wrapper that lets developers spawn autonomous multi-agent loops directly inside n8n workflows.
ideas.title: n8n-AgentBuilder: Visual Multi-Agent Orchestrator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the hackathon sponsor's ecosystem (n8n Pro plans) by building an extension that makes n8n natively agent-aware.

ideas.pitch: An zero-config auto-embedding toolkit that profiles database schemas and instantly sets up semantic search and data integrity checks.
ideas.title: AutoSchema: Autonomous Database RAG and Profiling Toolkit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses data profiling and integration pain points with high utility for full-stack engineers deploying database-backed AI features.
